Klasse SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient

java.lang.Object
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.network.SEDAPExpressCommunicator
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.network.SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient
public class SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient extends SEDAPExpressCommunicator
Acoustic SEDAP-Express communicator using GGWave, JNA and Java Sound. The GGWave native library is loaded by GGWaveLib. Make sure that the matching native library (architecture and operating system) is available through java.library.path / jna.library.path before this class is initialized.
Autor:
Volker Voß

    • SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient

      public SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient()
      Creates a GGWave communicator using the audible-fast transmit protocol.

    • SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient

      public SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient(int txProtocolId, int txVolume, int audioBufferSamples)
      Creates a sedapexpress ggwave client instance.
      Parameter:
      txProtocolId - GGWave transmit protocol, e.g. AUDIBLE_FAST or AUDIBLE_NORMAL
      txVolume - transmit volume (0..100)
      audioBufferSamples - number of mono audio samples read per microphone operation

    • SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient

      public SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient(int txProtocolId, int txVolume, int audioBufferSamples, int fragmentDataSize)
      Creates a sedapexpress ggwave client instance.
      Parameter:
      txProtocolId - GGWave transmit protocol
      txVolume - transmit volume (0..100)
      audioBufferSamples - microphone samples per read operation
      fragmentDataSize - application data bytes per GGWave fragment

    • SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient

      public SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient(int txProtocolId, int txVolume, int audioBufferSamples, int fragmentDataSize, String localSenderId)
      Creates a communicator with an explicit local SEDAP sender identifier. The classification defaults to the system property sedap.classification or U.
      Parameter:
      txProtocolId - value for tx protocol id
      txVolume - value for tx volume
      audioBufferSamples - value for audio buffer samples
      fragmentDataSize - value for fragment data size
      localSenderId - value for local sender id

    • SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient

      public SEDAPExpressGGWaveClient(int txProtocolId, int txVolume, int audioBufferSamples, int fragmentDataSize, String localSenderId, String localClassification)
      Creates a sedapexpress ggwave client instance.
      Parameter:
      txProtocolId - value for tx protocol id
      txVolume - value for tx volume
      audioBufferSamples - value for audio buffer samples
      fragmentDataSize - value for fragment data size
      localSenderId - SEDAP-Express sender identifier used for ACKNOWLEDGE messages
      localClassification - SEDAP classification (P/U/R/C/S/T)
